title: Hurmala ne Teer se Cheda Gala Besheer ka
body:
Hurmula ne teer se cheda gala besheer ka..
Khoon se sukha Gala tar Ho Gaya besheer ka..
Zalimo se bole sarwar pyasa hai asghar mera..
Halq me kateN pade hai Kab se hai sukha gala...
Tashngi se haal dekho kya hua beshir ka...
Bund paani na mila to Bete se bole imam
Khushq Hontho ko dikha ke Kar do ab Hujjat tamam..
Lashkar e aada ne dekha Hosla besheer ka..
Garm reti par sulaya shah ne jab ye gulab
Dard ka manzar na dekhe Khaime se Umme rabab
Pusht par chhale pade aur tan jala besheer ka..
Aab ke badle gale per hurmula ka teer hai
Teer e sheh shoba se Zakhmi bazu e shabbeer hai
Khoon jitna tha badan me bah gaya besheer ka..
Hath me khune Ali tha or Husaain ibn e ali..
AasmaaN raazi nahi tha Na zameeN razi huwi..
Apne chehre pe lahu sheh ne mala besheer ka
Aage badhte thy kabhi peeche hataa'te the kadam..
Soch ker ye janib e khaima chale shaahe umam..
Haal kya maa'N ko bataunga bhala besheer ka
Kabr se bahar nikala Shimr ne nanha sa phool..
Dil kate aale nabi ke kampi hai Rooh e batool
Samne jab Maa'N ke haaye Sar kata besheer ka..
Ghurbat e shabeer bhi shabber pe rone lagi..
Tar ali asghar ki turbat sheh ne jab ashqo se ki..
Pyaas ne asmee padha jab marsiya besheer ka..
